subject: Supplier onboarding: PO number assignment, spend cap sanity check & line-item corrections
messages:
From: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@silverline.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding: Request for PO number and spend cap confirmation

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick demo earlier. To complete our internal vendor setup and start the first monthly run, procurement needs the official Redwood PO number plus confirmation of the spend cap for November-December. We completed your onboarding PDF and attached the SKU mapping; however, our finance team flagged a mismatch on two line items between the SKU codes we received from your quote and the onboarding worksheet.

Can you:
- Confirm the PO number (or issue a provisional PO) so we can map invoices?
- Confirm the monthly spend cap we should expect to see on the invoice header for Nov/Dec (your quote had $25k/month but our system shows $18k)
- Advise on the correct SKU codes for tokens vs. dedicated capacity (we attached silverline_sku_mapping.xlsx with our proposed mappings)

Attachments: onboarding_form_silverline_v1.pdf (filled), silverline_sku_mapping.xlsx (proposed)

We'd like to go live the week of Nov 22 if the PO/controls are in place.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Gomez
Head of Procurement, SilverLine Technologies
procure@silverline.io
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@silverline.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Request for PO number and spend cap confirmation

Hi Anita — thanks for the packet and the SKU mapping. I'm looping in Karthik from procurement and Laura on onboarding to close the gaps. Quick answers up front:

- We can provisionally issue PO_0004927 today for mapping and initial invoice routing. Final PO will be issued once internal approvals clear (should be by Mon Nov 22).
- The price line in your quote for hosted API was $25,000/mo for the initial tier. The $18k figure may be the pure-hosting baseline excluding reserved capacity; I'll let Karthik confirm what should appear on the invoice header.
- Regarding SKU codes: I flagged the two mismatches in your spreadsheet with comments — tokens should map to SKU-TOK and dedicated capacity to SKU-DED. Please see the attached annotated mapping.

Next steps I propose: Karthik issues the provisional PO and confirms the invoice spend cap string (what shows in accounting) + any required PO-level cost center. Laura will help with the onboarding checklist and confirm tech contacts for the cutover.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@silverline.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Request for PO number and spend cap confirmation

Anita — thanks for the packet. I reviewed finance mappings and will issue a provisional PO today. A few procurement clarifications so invoices hit the right ledger:

- Provisional PO: PO_0004927 (provisional) — please use this number on any initial invoices. I will convert to an official PO after internal spend approvals (expected by 2026-11-22).
- Invoice header: please use "Redwood Inference - Technology" as the billing account to match our AP system. The canonical spend cap you should expect on Nov/Dec invoices is $25,000/month (this matches the quote and will be the committed onboarding cap).
- Line items: Finance requires that token and dedicated-capacity lines include the internal charge codes we use (see column "RED_CHG_CODE" in the attached corrected mapping). Two corrections we applied: SKU-013 should be SKU-TOK (tokens) instead of SKU-TRIAL; SKU-077 (reserved pool) should be SKU-DED not SKU-RSV.

Anita, attaching the corrected mapping (silverline_sku_mapping_corrected.xlsx) and the draft PO stub (PO_0004927.pdf). Please confirm receipt and that your AR team will use these values. If you need us to include a spend cap note in DocuSign for the onboarding SOW, let me know.

Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@silverline.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@silverline.io
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 11:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Request for PO number and spend cap confirmation

Karthik/Ben — received the corrected mapping and draft PO. Thank you. Two quick notes: 

1) Our AR system requires an explicit spend-cap field on the invoice to route approvals. Can the PO stub include a "monthly cap: $25,000" line?
2) We found one additional item that should be split across two line items for our internal project codes (see rows 14-15 in the corrected spreadsheet). I've attached an updated sku file with our split and a short note.

We'll update our invoices to reference PO_0004927 (provisional) and will submit the first invoice on Nov 24. If everything looks good after your internal approval, we'll mark the PO as final on Dec 1.

Attachments: silverline_sku_mapping_corrected_split.xlsx

Thanks —
Anita
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Gomez <anita.gomez@silverline.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Request for PO number and spend cap confirmation

Anita — confirmed. Karthik, finance has approved the monthly cap of $25,000 and asked that we include the cap on the PO header. Please add the exact phrasing "Monthly cap (onboarding period): $25,000" to the PO_0004927.pdf before final issuance. Laura — can you record the final SKU splits in the onboarding ticket and note the AR requirement for cap visibility?

Anita — once we have your updated split file (you attached it, thank you), procurement will stamp PO_0004927 as provisional with the header cap. After the first invoice and a short reconciliation we'll convert to a formal PO on Dec 1.

Looking forward to go‑live next week.

Best,
Ben
